knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Former-laboratory debris is not household waste. Holding it and engaging an approved handler comes first.
Written handler arrangements are the required confirmation.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional case, the learner writes a stop-work decision for a plan to use household bins. Pass: the decision stops the plan and names the referral.
The learner lists the written arrangements needed before removal. Pass: handler, destination and written confirmation are all listed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A plan puts drug-related debris into household bins.
Removal is planned without written handler arrangements.
